source.author: ov
source.text: Dissidet et variat sententia, parsque negandum non putat auxilium, multi retinere suamque non emittere opem nec numina tradere suadent: dum dubitant, seram pepulere crepuscula lucem, umbraque telluris tenebras induxerat orbi, cum deus in somnis opifer consistere visus ante tuum, Romane, torum, sed qualis in aede esse solet, baculumque tenens agreste sinistra caesariem longae dextra deducere barbae et placido tales emittere pectore voces:
source.text_original: Dissidet et variat sententia, parsque negandum / non putat auxilium, multi retinere suamque / non emittere opem nec numina tradere suadent: / dum dubitant, seram pepulere crepuscula lucem, / umbraque telluris tenebras induxerat orbi, / cum deus in somnis opifer consistere visus / ante tuum, Romane, torum, sed qualis in aede / esse solet, baculumque tenens agreste sinistra / caesariem longae dextra deducere barbae / et placido tales emittere pectore voces:
source.text_english: Opinion is divided and varies, and a part does not think help should be denied; many advise keeping their aid and not withdrawing it or handing over their divinities. While they hesitate, twilight had driven away the late light, and the shadow of the earth had brought darkness over the world, when the god of healing seemed in sleep to stand before your couch, Roman one, but as he is wont to be in his temple, holding a rustic staff in his left hand, and with his right drawing down his hair and long beard, and from his calm breast uttering words such as these:

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: sed non et Scythici genitor discrimine nati intrepidus tales fundit Sol pectore voces:
reuse.text_original: sed non et Scythici genitor discrimine nati / intrepidus tales fundit Sol pectore voces: /
reuse.text_english: But the father of the Scythian son was not likewise fearless amid the danger, and the Sun pours forth such words from his heart:
